title: The State of Independent Salon and Barbershop Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent salon and barbershop websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/salons/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent hair salons, barbershops, colour and specialty salons and salons with spa services
findings: Only 3% of the 193 independent hair salon and barbershop websites we scanned say whether a client in a wheelchair can get in.
A typical site answers four of the nine questions clients ask before choosing (mean 3.5).
The median overall score is 78 out of 100 (mean 78).
The least-answered questions are "Can I get in with a wheelchair?" (3%), "Do other clients vouch for you?" (18%) and "Can I just walk in?" (20%).
The best-answered are "Can I book my stylist online?" (72%) and "When are you open?" (62%).
By kind of business, the highest median score is 79 (hair salons), against 79 for barbershops, 77 for colour and specialty salons and 76 for salons with spa services.
84% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
84% fail "HairSalon, BarberShop or BeautySalon structured data" (Schema.org · HairSalon).

technical.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
HairSalon, BarberShop or BeautySalon structured data

agencyProblems.label: Physical accessibility stated
agencyProblems.question: Can I get in with a wheelchair?
agencyProblems.fix: One plain line on the contact page: step-free entrance or not, the floor, an elevator, accessible parking, a shampoo station that suits a wheelchair.
agencyProblems.pitch: A client who uses a wheelchair cannot tell from your site whether they can get through the door.

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image and gallery photos, defer the booking and Instagram scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on a client’s phone.

agencyProblems.label: HairSalon, BarberShop or BeautySalon structured data
agencyProblems.fix: Add HairSalon or BarberShop structured data with the name, address, phone, opening hours and booking link.
agencyProblems.pitch: Search engines and assistants have to guess when you are open and how to book.

agencyProblems.label: Reviews marked up, in a widget or quoted
agencyProblems.question: Do other clients vouch for you?
agencyProblems.fix: Show recent client reviews on the home page through a review widget or Review structured data, with the source named.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your clients praise you on Google every week, and none of it is on your own site.

agencyProblems.label: Walk-ins or appointment only stated
agencyProblems.question: Can I just walk in?
agencyProblems.fix: One line beside the hours: walk-ins welcome, walk-ins when a chair is free, or by appointment only.
agencyProblems.pitch: A client standing outside wants to know whether to walk in or book, and your site does not say.
